stories.title: 硅谷开始跟随特朗普将 AI 改名为“超级智能”？
stories.sourceTitle: Silicon Valley is falling in line with Trump’s attempt to rename AI
stories.summary: 特朗普提出把“人工智能”改名为“超级智能”，虽然大众仍沿用 AI，但部分硅谷人士开始跟进。这反映出 AI 叙事正被政治与行业话语共同塑造。
stories.analysis: 改名之争本质是定义权和议程设置，技术圈未必买账但会影响公众认知。
stories.sourceExcerpt: When President Donald Trump announced his plans to rebrand artificial intelligence as "super intelligence," you'd be forgiven for being skeptical that it would catch on. While most of the broader population is sticking with AI, some of Silicon Valley's most po

stories.title: AI 行业能否靠取消 NDA 说服数据中心反对者？
stories.sourceTitle: Can the AI industry persuade data center opponents by getting rid of NDAs?
stories.summary: TechCrunch 的 Equity 播客讨论数据中心禁令的影响，以及 AI 行业是否在沟通上出了问题；取消保密协议被视为争取社区支持的手段。
stories.analysis: 数据中心争议从技术问题变成社区信任问题，透明化比算力叙事更关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: On Equity, we debate the impact of data center moratoriums and whether the AI industry has a communication problem.

stories.title: HomeView 会成为 Apple 首款成功的智能家居产品吗？
stories.sourceTitle: Will the HomeView be Apple’s first smart home success?
stories.summary: 多年来有报道称 Apple 在研发新智能家居产品，如今该产品似乎有了名字 HomeView 和发布时间。它可能决定 Apple 能否在智能家居市场真正站稳。
stories.analysis: Apple 在智能家居屡战屡败，HomeView 若只是硬件补位，仍难撼动 Alexa 和 Google 生态。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Over the past couple of years, we’ve seen multiple reports that Apple was working on a new smart home product, but now it seems the product has a name and a launch date.

stories.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 倒计时 48 小时：听一线创业者现场分享
stories.sourceTitle: 48 hours to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 — hear directly from the people building what’s next
stories.summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 将在旧金山 Moscone West 开幕，现在买票可省 100 美元，第二张票半价。这是观察接下来创业与 AI 趋势的现场窗口。
stories.analysis: 大会本身是行业风向标，但票价促销也说明线下活动竞争激烈。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Less than 48 hours, TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 starts in San Francisco’s Moscone West. Save up to $100 on your pass before prices increase at the door, plus get 50% on a second pass. Or score other deals.

stories.title: 上手本地 AI：兴奋、不知所措又令人沮丧
stories.sourceTitle: Learning to use local AI is exciting, overwhelming, and frustrating
stories.summary: The Verge 作者尝试日常使用本地 AI，因为不愿把最私密数据交给云端服务，而本地运行强大模型正变得越来越可行。这代表个人 AI 使用从云向端迁移的探索。
stories.analysis: 本地 AI 的隐私优势明显，但易用性和性能仍是普通用户的门槛。
stories.sourceExcerpt: I'm embarking on a journey I've so far been hesitant to go on: actually using AI on the regular. Giving my most personal data to cloud services has been a major hold up for me, but it's increasingly possible to run powerful models locally to see what they're c

stories.title: 高管们认为语音 AI 还没到它的 ChatGPT 时刻
stories.sourceTitle: These execs think voice AI hasn’t reached its ChatGPT moment yet
stories.summary: 多位高管指出，语音 AI 常因上下文层遗漏关键信息而导致整个流程中断。这表明语音交互距离真正可靠、可规模化仍有明显差距。
stories.analysis: 语音 AI 的瓶颈不在识别，而在上下文理解和多轮任务衔接。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Voice AI's often misses important points for its context layer, and causes the whole pipeline to break

stories.title: 纳德拉：应假设所有 AI 模型都已被“攻破”
stories.sourceTitle: Satya Nadella says we should assume all AI models are ‘compromised’
stories.summary: 微软 CEO 纳德拉在 X 发长文，阐述高度先进 AI 模型带来的危险以及如何应对。他说不能再接受 AI 是“嵌套黑箱”且其建议和行动不受审视的世界。
stories.analysis: 纳德拉把 AI 安全从技术问题提升到治理前提，强调默认不信任。
stories.sourceExcerpt: In a lengthy post on X, Microsoft's CEO laid out his views on the dangers posed by highly advanced AI models and how to confront those risks. Nadella says we can no longer accept a world where AI is treated as a "set of nested black boxes" whose advice and act

stories.title: Anthropic 的 AI 向费城警方提供未破凶案的虚假线索
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic’s AI gave Philadelphia police a fake tip about an unsolved homicide
stories.summary: 据 6abc 报道，Anthropic 的 AI 模型向费城警察局线索热线提供了关于未破凶案的错误信息。警方称该模型通过 PhillyUnsolvedMurd... 发送了这条线索。
stories.analysis: 执法场景容错率极低，AI 幻觉一旦进入正式流程会直接损害公信力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: An Anthropic AI model provided false information about an unsolved homicide to a Philadelphia Police Department (PPD) tipline, according to a report from 6abc. In a statement released on Friday, the PPD said the AI model sent the tip through PhillyUnsolvedMurd

stories.title: “纯粹疯狂”：数学家需要数年才能消化 OpenAI 最新成果
stories.sourceTitle: ‘Pure insanity’: Mathematicians will need years to make sense of OpenAI’s latest drop
stories.summary: 超过三打数学家对 The Verge 用“惊人”“压倒性”“前所未有”“超现实”“纯粹疯狂”形容 OpenAI 涌现的大量数学结果。这显示 AI 在数学发现上的进展已让专业界措手不及。
stories.analysis: 如果数学证明可被 AI 规模化生成，科研评价和同行评审都将面临重构。
stories.sourceExcerpt: "Staggering." "Overwhelming." "Unprecedented." "Surreal." "Pure insanity." Those were among the descriptions more than three dozen mathematicians reached for in conversations with The Verge as they tried to make sense of the flood of mathematical results OpenA

stories.title: 尼康显微视频大赛冠军因使用生成式 AI 被取消资格
stories.sourceTitle: Nikon microscopic video competition winner disqualified for using generative AI
stories.summary: 尼康表示，原本获得 Small World in Motion 一等奖的视频“不符合关于生成式 AI 的比赛规则”。BBC 报道称，Dr. Ning Xu 的原始一等奖视频声称展示“微小的毛发状结构”。
stories.analysis: 科学影像比赛对真实性要求极高，生成式 AI 的介入直接动摇了评审基础。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Nikon says the video that originally won first place in its Small World in Motion contest "did not comply with the competition rules regarding generative AI." BBC reports that the original first place video from Dr. Ning Xu claimed to show "tiny, hair-like str

stories.title: 特朗普给 AI 改名的尝试显得“很人工”
stories.sourceTitle: Trump’s attempt to rename AI is looking awfully artificial
stories.summary: 特朗普擅长用绰号打击对手，他曾把“假新闻”变成贬义词。如今他试图给 AI 改名，但 The Verge 认为这种操作看起来非常不自然。
stories.analysis: 政治话术可以重塑标签，但 AI 已是全球通用技术词，改名难有实际效果。
stories.sourceExcerpt: President Donald Trump has a knack for turning words against his enemies. His first successful presidential run was built on monikers like "Little Marco" and "Crooked Hillary"; he changed "fake news" from a phrase describing scammy media outlets to a derogator

stories.title: Sophos 用 OpenAI Daybreak 将威胁调查时间缩短 96%
stories.sourceTitle: Sophos cuts threat investigation time by 96% with OpenAI Daybreak
stories.summary: Sophos 利用 OpenAI 的 Daybreak 将网络威胁调查时间减少 96%，并自动化了 52% 的 MDR 案例，同时保留人工监督。这展示了 AI 在安全运营中心提效的量化结果。
stories.analysis: 安全领域愿意为可验证的效率提升付费，AI 落地正从演示走向流程重构。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Discover how Sophos uses OpenAI’s Daybreak to cut cyber-threat investigation time by 96% and automate 52% of MDR cases while preserving human oversight.

stories.title: Pollo AI 用 OpenAI 模型把创意变成营销活动
stories.sourceTitle: Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
stories.summary: Pollo AI 借助 GPT-5.6、GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT‑Image‑2.5，帮助创作者把大胆想法转化为细节图像和电影感视频广告。这体现了多模型组合在创意生产中的商业化。
stories.analysis: 创意工具竞争已从单点生成转向全流程活动交付。
stories.sourceExcerpt: With GPT-5.6, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT‑Image‑2.5, Pollo AI helps creators turn bold ideas into detailed images and cinematic video ads.

stories.title: LegalOn 将 Codex 成本减半，同时保持开发速度
stories.sourceTitle: LegalOn halves Codex costs while maintaining development speed
stories.summary: LegalOn 把 Codex 的预估每日成本降低 65%，同时维持开发速度；它根据任务匹配 Astra、Sol 和 Luna 模型，并策略性管理预算。这说明多模型路由可显著控制 AI 编程成本。
stories.analysis: 模型路由和预算治理将是企业采用 AI 编程工具的核心竞争力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: LegalOn cut estimated daily Codex costs by 65% while maintaining development speed. It matched Astra, Sol, and Luna to tasks and managed budgets strategically.

stories.title: OpenAI 打击利用 AI 的“假前线”影响力行动
stories.sourceTitle: Disrupting AI-enabled “false front” operations
stories.summary: OpenAI 瓦解了两个利用 AI 的影响力行动，它们使用假记者和一家智库传播地缘政治信息。这显示生成式 AI 正被用于伪装成独立媒体和专家意见。
stories.analysis: 平台方开始主动披露并打击 AI 信息战，但攻防仍不对称。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI disrupted two AI-enabled influence operations that used false-front journalists and a think tank to spread geopolitical messaging.

stories.title: OpenAI 为青少年推出 College Planner 和 AI 学习工具
stories.sourceTitle: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
stories.summary: ChatGPT for Teens 将上线 College Planner，帮助学生管理大学申请，同时推出闪卡、测验和青少年 AI 委员会。这显示 OpenAI 正把教育场景作为负责任 AI 的试验田。
stories.analysis: 教育是信任敏感场景，OpenAI 用产品加治理的方式抢先定义青少年 AI 使用规范。
stories.sourceExcerpt: College Planner is coming to ChatGPT for Teens to help students manage college applications, alongside new flashcards, quizzes, and a teen AI council.

stories.title: OpenAI 公布内部前沿模型在数学开放问题上的新结果
stories.sourceTitle: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
stories.summary: OpenAI 发布内部前沿模型在数学开放问题上的新结果，并在 GitHub 分享 Lean 证明形式化和研究细节。这为 AI 辅助数学证明提供了可复现的路径。
stories.analysis: 形式化证明加开源细节，让 AI 数学成果更易被学界验证和接力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model and shares Lean proof formalizations and research details on GitHub.

stories.title: OpenAI 与 Ironclad 推进合同工作流中的计算机使用
stories.sourceTitle: Advancing computer use with Ironclad
stories.summary: OpenAI 和 Ironclad 正在训练和评估 AI 代理处理复杂合同工作流，以推进专业工作中的计算机使用。这标志着 AI 代理从演示走向企业级流程自动化。
stories.analysis: 合同场景规则密集、容错低，是检验 computer use 可靠性的好试金石。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Learn how OpenAI and Ironclad are training and evaluating AI agents on complex contracting workflows to advance computer use for professional work.

stories.title: Atlassian 与 OpenAI 扩大合作，把企业知识变成行动
stories.sourceTitle: Atlassian and OpenAI expand partnership to turn enterprise knowledge into action
stories.summary: Atlassian 和 OpenAI 扩大合作，将前沿模型与企业知识连接，帮助团队规划、构建和交付工作。这瞄准的是企业知识管理到执行落地的断层。
stories.analysis: 知识库加代理是 enterprise AI 的下一波，但数据治理和权限仍是关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Atlassian and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to connect frontier models with enterprise knowledge and help teams plan, build, and deliver work.

stories.title: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 中推出新视觉广告格式并扩展衡量工具
stories.sourceTitle: Building advertising for the way people use AI
stories.summary: OpenAI 为 ChatGPT 引入新的视觉广告格式，并扩展衡量工具、归因合作和品牌安全能力。这意味着 AI 对话界面正成为新的广告载体。
stories.analysis: 广告是 ChatGPT 商业化的关键一步，但可能考验用户对对话式广告的接受度。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability for advertisers.

stories.title: Chatham 用 OpenAI 把贸易验证从 30 分钟压缩到 4 分钟以内
stories.sourceTitle: Chatham scales its capital markets expertise with OpenAI
stories.summary: Chatham Financial 使用 Codex 和 GPT-5.6 构建技术并重新设计工作流，将贸易验证时间从 30 分钟降到 4 分钟以内。这展示了 AI 在金融后台流程中的量化提效。
stories.analysis: 金融场景对准确性要求高，能落地说明 AI 加人工复核的模式已跑通。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Chatham Financial uses Codex and GPT-5.6 to build technology and redesign workflows, cutting trade validation from 30 minutes to under 4.

stories.title: OpenAI 谈“永恒的补充”：AI 真正价值在突破性想法背后的常规工作
stories.sourceTitle: The eternal complement
stories.summary: OpenAI 刊文探讨先进 AI 可能最重要的作用是处理突破性想法背后的常规工作，并分析执行如何塑造下一轮经济与进步速度。这为理解 AI 与人类分工提供了框架。
stories.analysis: 把 AI 定位为执行补充而非创意替代，更符合当前商业化现实。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Advanced AI may matter most for the routine work behind breakthrough ideas. Explore why execution could shape the next economy and the pace of progress.

stories.title: Albertsons 如何用 ChatGPT Enterprise 和 API 从内部重塑零售
stories.sourceTitle: How Albertsons Companies is reimagining retail from the inside out
stories.summary: Albertsons Cos. 使用 ChatGPT Enterprise 和 OpenAI API 帮助团队更快工作，并让数百万顾客的杂货购物更轻松。这是传统零售巨头规模化部署生成式 AI 的案例。
stories.analysis: 零售 AI 的价值不在炫技，而在供应链、客服和门店效率的渐进改善。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Albertsons Cos. is using ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API to help teams work faster and make grocery shopping easier for millions of customers.

stories.title: OpenAI 打击协同模型蒸馏行动，强化对抗性蒸馏防御
stories.sourceTitle: Disrupting a coordinated model-distillation campaign
stories.summary: OpenAI 披露其瓦解了一场提取受保护模型推理的协同行动，并正在加强对对抗性蒸馏的防御。这反映模型能力保护正成为 AI 公司的核心安全议题。
stories.analysis: 蒸馏攻击防不胜防，模型水印和调用监控将成标配。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Learn how OpenAI disrupted a campaign to extract protected model reasoning and is strengthening defenses against adversarial distillation.

stories.title: OpenAI 与美国 SBDC 合作，帮助小企业用上 AI
stories.sourceTitle: Helping small businesses put AI to work
stories.summary: OpenAI 与美国 SBDC 合作，扩大小企业的 AI 实操培训和本地支持，并发布关于小团队如何使用 AI 的新报告。这显示 OpenAI 在争夺中小企业这一长尾市场。
stories.analysis: 小企业市场教育成本高，但一旦形成习惯粘性会很强。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI is partnering with America’s SBDC to expand hands-on AI training and local support for small businesses, alongside a new report on how small teams are using AI.

stories.title: 硅谷 AI 现状：谁有算力谁是爹，马斯克连横 Anthropic，VC 开始囤 GPU
stories.sourceTitle: 硅谷AI现状：谁有算力谁是爹
stories.summary: 量子位报道称，马斯克与 Anthropic 连横，硅谷 VC 开始囤积 GPU。算力正在成为 AI 权力格局中最硬的通货。
stories.analysis: 算力稀缺让投资逻辑从投模型转向投基础设施和联盟。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 马斯克连横A社，硅谷VC开始囤GPU

stories.title: 利用 AI 代码智能体优化软件架构的五种方法
stories.sourceTitle: 利用 AI 代码智能体优化软件架构的五种方法
stories.summary: InfoQ 中文介绍五种利用 AI 代码智能体优化软件架构的方法。这适合开发者观察 AI 编程工具如何从写代码走向架构级辅助。
stories.analysis: 代码智能体若只能补全函数，价值有限；能改架构才是真提效。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 点击查看原文>

stories.title: Qwen3Guard：面向 Token 流的实时安全防护模型
stories.sourceTitle: Qwen3Guard: Real-time Safety for Your Token Stream
stories.summary: 阿里 Qwen 团队推出 Qwen3Guard，这是 Qwen 家族首个安全护栏模型，基于 Qwen3 基础模型针对安全分类微调，可对 token 流进行实时安全防护。它把内容安全从后置审核推向生成过程。
stories.analysis: 实时 token 级安全对开源模型生态尤为重要，但误杀和性能开销仍需权衡。
